rows.TEXT: Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in her times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended her reign of terror. She is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to her will.

Ku'quandar:"Ha Ha! Yes, Master! We have taken the city to the east - Brantburg is ours! Most of the villagers escaped to the city of Brightburg; the next city our armies are eager to topple! Onwards with the Legion!"

Snurki 
"The Grey fog rolling towards us from Mount Anjajuar worries the populace, Milord... It is a most foreboding sight!"

Weric Greybeard"Yes! What is causing this unnatural fog? Perhaps it carries plague - or spirits dwell in its center? We do not yet understand... I will send our armies north, to Mount Anjajuar. I must discover the source of this phenomena!"
Lich"Yes... The voice - one with no language, one that describes without words!"
Archlich"The seed of our revival resides here... We must guard it against all living beings, for many will seek to destroy our new life."

NEW OBJECTIVE: 
Defend the fountain against invaders.

Specter"Hark! A new duty - spread the plague buried with our corpses 200 years ago. Go far and wide; all of this land must lie beneath our ashen banner! Those slain will be added to our army 200 years hence!"

NEW OBJECTIVE: 
Defend the fountain against invaders.Transform 60% of the land into Undead territory.

Elf Lord"You can cause us no harm! Our magic is much too strong. I wish only to help... You would do well to listen to my words! You have been tricked! Brought to life again - to be slaves! You are not living, and your thoughts are not your own!"

Shadiel"Only you can save yourselves! Go South, down the mountain... There is a cemetery beneath a waterfall. You will find the master of your fate hiding there. This is my advice - May you be helped by it, unfortunate ones!"
Specter"He disappears before we have the chance to strike him down! No matter, we must make this lush grotto our sterile domain."

Banshee"Wait - The soil does not die under my touch! Their lands are relentlessly green. What magic is this? How is it that I do not remember these wondrous elves and their ways? In fact... I can remember nothing!"
Hraddoc"Milord! Hark! We report to you news of our expedition - our expedition to the summit of Mount Anjajuar!"
Weric Greybeard"Mount Anjajuar? So you have explored the grey fog that has enveloped the mountain? What news?"

Hraddoc"It is the Anjajuar! They have been resurrected - the inhabitants of the Anjajuar Mountains!!! 200 years ago a plague wiped out their kind... And now - their bodies have wasted away, yet they have strength to fight, and powers besides!"
Snurki"The Anjajuar!? How and why have they been revived?"
Weric Greybeard"We must discover this... A party has been sent to the Mountain already! Send your scouts - prepare the troops for what you have already seen!"

Snurki 
"Milord! Last eve I studied the texts of Guanta... I sought answers. The text speaks of a beautiful fountain which the Anjajuar had guarded in life."
Snurki"I believe that we should seek this fountain! It is written that it holds sway over the Anjajuar in life and in death. Perhaps this has granted the Anjajuar their horrible half-life!"
Weric Greybeard"To the summit of Mount Anjajuar! Discover the fountain! But be wary! Our road is paved with peril!"
Demonologist"Sire, a new enemy crawls in our midst - a grey army of undead!"

Demonologist"They are the ancient race of the Anjajuar  - back to rule their mountain again after so long! Their return from beyond the veil of death is a mystery... I wish to investigate this, Master."
Ziggamuak"Yes! Resurrecting an entire race is great indeed! We must have this power at the back of the Legions! No other race shall possess the craft... What could stop us then?"
Pandemoneus"Master, last eve I studied the texts of Guanta... In them they speak of a beautiful fountain which the Anjajuar guarded."
Pandemoneus"I believe that we should seek this fountain. For it is written that it holds sway over the Anjajuar in life and in death!"
Pandemoneus"We must go into Anjajuar territory to seek the fountain! All the way to the very summit of the great Mount Anjajuar!"
Lord Ziggamuak"Your work is impressive. Spread the word! We must do our all to find the fountain which controls life and death!"
Peasant"No! You will not destroy our City as you did Brantburg!"
Archlich"These mass graves were for 200 years our resting place... Now we, the Anjajuar, have crawled from these pits to the surface once again! Sweet freedom!"
Demon"Aaah! It is beautiful! I can feel power emanating from its shimmering surface!"
Fiend"It is ours! Master... We can rule over the living with armies of dead!"
King's Guard"Here it is, the fountain is ours..."
Ghost"We have spread the plague over the lands. The voice is soothing now... It tries to silence us! No we must... not die... again... not again!"
Tenderfoot"The Shopkeeper offered me an ocean charm! Perhaps we should go back and claim the trinket?"
Tenderfoot"I cannot believe that the shopkeeper would give away a beautiful object such as this! He says that seashells are considered unlucky by his kind."
Mermaid"Wait! I heard you speak of a charm. Pardon me, but I am that charm's rightful owner! It is true that it has no real value, but for me, it has much... It was a gift, and was lost long ago."
Tenderfoot"Well, we shall return it to you, fair lady!"
Mermaid"And in return I give you this to aid you at sea."
Fensbuch"People of Anjajuar?! What sent you here - towards me! Those were not my orders!"
Lich"Yes! I remember this man's voice! He is the source of the voice... I recognize its tone."
Banshee"But... The voice has not guided me for some time now. My mind has been quiet, and empty. I think it was not always this way!"
Fensbuch"Ah! I have begun to lose my sway over the horde... They have strayed too far from the fountain to be controlled!"
Lich"Ha ha ha! We are free to do as we wish! What shall we do with this - the thing that dared control us!"
Fensbuch "Please! It is not me that you must destroy. It is the fountain which truly holds your lives in its hands. It is that which you must destroy to be free!"
Lich"Silence! We will decide your fate - and our own - from this time forward!"
Tenderfoot"The Shopkeeper offered me an ocean charm! Perhaps we should go back and claim the trinket?"
Legions Messenger"Do not even attempt to reach the fountain! We will only hunt you down and destroy you if you succeed in finding it... You have no chance, Half-men!
Clan Messenger"We wont let you gain control of the fountain! We will not rest until it is ours..."
Doragon"Over here! Yes here - the Dragon Statue! I know you cannot see me... But I need your help! I have been trapped in this statue by the cowardly Shopkeeper, Yeggar."

Doragon"His Shop is nearby... Steal Doragons eye from the scoundrel when he isn't looking! It is in his inventory, and it is priceless - for it contains my essence! The one who owns it controls me; unless I am in my own territory!"
Cultist"A magical eye! Shall we steal it and help the trapped beast? Let's go to the shop and see if we can spy it in his inventory..."

Doragon"Thank you! I am still weak from being imprisoned for so long in this stone, but I will still pledge my life to you - I owe it! Although I must return home in 15 days time, I shall surely perish without the proper rest after my ordeal..."
Lich"Our master is gone. Now my mind is quiet! And alone..."
Arch-Lich"I remember! Faces, towns, friends... I remember life as it once was!"
Lich"What is to become of us? How are we to make a life in this world as a monster?"
Doragon"We are nearing my lair! Thank you, my  brothers, I leave you here... Take this, one of my most precious treasures."
Pandemoneus"Where is this great beast's treasure trove? Search the area!"

Possessed 
"We found the dragon's lair, Master. It yielded a handsome reward indeed!"
Specter"The voice, I cannot hear it any longer. It has faded. What is our purpose here?"
Cultist"We are getting closer to Mount Anjajuar! The mysterious fountain is within our reach!"
Demon"Ha Ha! The Legions destroy everything in their path! We must continue our rampage to the west, the foothills of Mount Anjajuar lie there."
Moloch"First Brantburg fell, now Brightburg!  Our domain will spread far and wide."

Demon 
"We are in Mountain Clan territory now, sire... We have no business in these parts, for the fountain is our one desire! The artifact which rules death!"
Cultist"The Greenskins are the only creatures which have made Mount Anjajuar their home in past years. The climate and the memory of plague keeps all intelligent creatures away."

Arch-Devil 
"Yes! We have now reached the foothills of Mount Anjajuar. The grey mist is almost upon us..."
Anti-Paladin"We have come this far... The gates which guard the fountain lay west; Through the mist."
Cultist"Let me examine this scroll. It may have some significance! I wonder what interest the Greenskins have in the implements of magic."
Druidess"The Barbarians have made these crude dwellings... This is the only place where they can live, free... Outside all civilization."
King's Guard"The foothills of Mount Anjajuar are upon us. If we can get to the fountain before the evil legions, all will be safe."
Engineer"Milord, we have strayed far from Mount Anjajuar... We have strayed so far as to be in Legions territory!"
Engineer"So now we enter Greenskins territory. The ignorant savages!"
Arch-Druidess"Wait! There is something hidden beneath this stone idol..."
Alchemist"I am afraid that the Legions will reach the Anjajuar before we. Milord, what would happen if the legions found the Anjajuar's fountain?"

King's Guard"Only Greenskins and Barbarians are foolish enough to live in this hostile clime. The shadow of the plague has clung to these mountainsides for 200 years. And now, the victims of the scourge have returned..."
Druidess"The foothills of Mount Anjajuar are upon us! If we can get the fountain before the evil legions, all will be safe..."
Loremaster"We may have beaten the demons to the summit. Now if we can just pass safely through the gates to the west, the clans will be safe. And the Anjajuar will be freed."
Lich"Yes! Try to stop us - mortals... We are death itself!"
Specter"Even the lesser creatures are affected by the plague that we bring!"
Zombie"What are we to do next, Master?"
Wraith"I am afraid! We have ventured far from the fountain. Is it still safe? And the voice of our Master has left us; we are alone..."
White Wizard"Back, Demons! Back to your unclean realm!"
Peasant"No! We will not let you corrupt the innocent any longer..."
Necromancer"The voice! The voice has dimmed... I no longer receive its counsel!"
Skeleton Warrior"We spread, we spread... Until the world is ours!"
Arch-Lich"Yes, that is what the voice - our Master - demands..."
Archlich"The plague fells all who dare approach us! This is our duty and our task..."
Initiate"Yes! More bodies have fallen - all for our master..."

Legions: 
Find the Fountain which is the source of the Anjajuar's revival. 
 
Clans: 
Find the Fountain and destroy its evil effects. 
 
Undead: 
Transform 60% of the Terrain. 
If an enemy reaches the fountain, your power will be lost.

Take a look! I have potions for every use!
I have some powerful new spells that might interest you.
I have spells for all... Please, come in!
I will train your units for a price.
Aye! You will find my animals fit and ready for battle!
Everything I possess is for sale.
